# Dr. Albert William Aguirre

> Biography and 2007 writings of Albert William Aguirre (January 10, 1944, Fresno, California – November 2013, Redding, California), who signed his work Al Aguirre, Ph., NMD, PhD. He built Doctor's Health Assurance and the Dr. Human Oil Change computer health program.

This is a public memorial archive. It contains his biography and the blog entries saved in the drhuman database on March 6, 2014. It does not contain patient records, accounts, or individual lab results.

Primary sources: [Find a Grave memorial 163344172](https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/163344172/albert_william-aguirre), [Fresno Bee obituary](https://www.legacy.com/us/obituaries/fresnobee/name/albert-aguirre-obituary?id=9793545), [his public profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dr-al-aguirre-08672650), [Doctor's Health Assurance at Shangrila Bio Spa](http://www.shangrilabiospa.com/doctors-health-assurance/), and the [source repository](https://github.com/sorob/drhumanoilchange).

## Biography

- [Biography and writings](https://sorob.github.io/drhumanoilchange/): life dates, family, education as he stated it, and the list of writings.
